seoTitle: Website Audit for Dentists in Leeds — Free Health Check
metaDescription: Free AI website audit for Leeds dental practices. Find out why your site isn't converting more new patient enquiries across the city.
intro: Leeds patients researching a new dentist typically compare two or three practice websites before booking, often on mobile, often anxious — the practice whose site loads fastest and makes booking easiest tends to win the enquiry regardless of which has the stronger reputation.
painPoints: Booking process requiring multiple steps or a phone call only, adding friction that loses anxious patients to a practice with instant online booking
No dedicated pages for high-intent treatments like Invisalign or implants, missing searches specific to what Leeds patients are actually looking for
Accessibility gaps (small text, low contrast, unlabelled forms) creating unnecessary barriers for older or anxious patients
Opening hours or emergency availability not clearly stated, a common source of lost enquiries during genuine dental emergencies

faq.question: Do Leeds patients compare multiple dental practice websites before booking?
faq.answer: Typically yes — most patients research two or three options before choosing, which means site speed, clarity and ease of booking often matter as much as reputation in winning the enquiry.

faq.question: Should a Leeds dental practice have a page for each treatment?
faq.answer: Yes, especially for higher-intent treatments like Invisalign or implants — dedicated pages let you rank for and directly answer those specific searches rather than relying on one general services page.

faq.question: How does accessibility affect a dental practice's enquiries?
faq.answer: Directly — many patients are older, anxious, or researching mid-emergency, so clear text, good contrast and properly labelled booking forms measurably affect how many visitors convert into booked appointments.
